scientific_integrity: The exact critical-lattice frame bounds are proved by Zak diagonalization, a simultaneously attained even-parity inequality, a three-term quadratic minimization, and a root-neighborhood weak-damping asymptotic. A standalone finite checker corroborates normalizations but cannot prove infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Integer-length truncated one-sided exponentials on the unit critical lattice only. Full-length evidence of the 2026 motivating preprint was unavailable, and older equivalent polyphase identities remain a bibliographic risk. No claim of independent verification.
title: Sharp parity-dependent conditioning of finite-duration exponential Gabor bases
